note: Read by 3ds/tools/azt.ps1. debug = the -Debug switch string of run_azahar.ps1, until = its -Until regex, cap = -Timeout in s, extra = more run_azahar.ps1 switches. first_marker is a log regex that must appear within deadline s after the Azahar start. expects = warp | tour | none (warp and tour turn on the attract-loop check). expected_events are log regexes that must all appear. status = verified | unverified | completion_only | fail_demo | pending.

scenarios.name: yard
scenarios.subject: Mario in his yard (kmr_20, entry 4), in control, at scene frames 200 and 204 (the shot writer takes one shot every 4 frames).
scenarios.proves: A preset start loads the yard map and runs steady frames with shots.

scenarios.name: tour10
scenarios.subject: Mario in each of 10 maps of the tour list. The list starts and ends on mac_00 (Toad Town).
scenarios.proves: tour= visits 10 maps by the real map change path, one shot burst per map change.
scenarios.debug: warp=mac_00:4 story=ch0_toad_town tour=mac_00:4,mac_01:0,dgb_01:1,kmr_09:0,kmr_20:4,hos_00:0,kmr_02:0,kmr_10:0,trd_01:0,mac_00:0 shots shotwin=999999:1 shotmode=4:21 phase phasecsv

scenarios.name: tour_k30
scenarios.subject: Mario in each map of tour_k30.txt (file has 6 maps: kmr_20, kmr_21, kmr_22, kmr_23, kmr_24, kmr_30) after a warp to arn_02.
scenarios.proves: warp= plus a story and a tour file from the SD folder runs to the end of the file.
scenarios.debug: warp=arn_02:0 story=ch0_toad_town tour=@tour_k30.txt texmax shots shotwin=999999:1 shotmode=4:21
scenarios.reason: Log checks pass (tour: done, 6 maps). Picture fails: 4 of 7 shots show a grey page, the Prologue title card and a text box. The shot timing fix (after each map load-done event plus 15 frames) needs a change in game source (pm_warp.c, pm_gpu.c), which this tool does not edit. The file has 6 maps, not 30.

scenarios.name: tour_no_warp
scenarios.subject: Deliberately wrong: a tour without warp=, preset= or story=. The game starts at the title and attract screen, and no map is loaded.
scenarios.proves: Fail-fast: the first marker is missing, azt.ps1 stops the run at the deadline and exits 2.
scenarios.reason: Demo of the fail-fast path. Not a test of the map tour.

scenarios.name: pause_menu
scenarios.subject: Pause status menu open at scene frame 178 (dialog: Check here to see what Mario's current status is.).

scenarios.reason: Known-good args from docs/handoff/agent_text.md and diag_dc.md. The shot writer takes one shot every 4 frames (170, 174, 178), so frame 181 is never written.

scenarios.name: battle_start
scenarios.subject: Battle scene (default formation: one Goomba on kmr_03), shots at frames 153 to 182 after the battle mode starts.
scenarios.proves: The battle debug switch starts a real battle from a warp.
scenarios.debug: warp=kmr_03:0 story=ch0_toad_town battle battlef=100 shots shotmode=8:30
scenarios.reason: Run 7 (until shot 29 frame) timed out at 90 s: the shot line holds a burst number, not the frame index. Until and expected event now use frame 182.

scenarios.name: attract_no_warp
scenarios.subject: Deliberately wrong: a tour without warp=. The start shows the title and attract (demo) screens and no map is loaded.
scenarios.proves: Attract detector: more than 2 title or demo mode lines in a run that expects a tour stop the run with ATTRACT LOOP.
scenarios.reason: ATTRACT LOOP verified live: 3 title or demo mode lines, stop at 39 s, exit 3 (run 1 of the reset budget).

scenarios.name: partner_menu
scenarios.subject: Pause menu, partner tab, shot frames 200 to 239 (pause from START*3 after wait80, then R*2 three times and A*2).
scenarios.proves: The padscript from docs/handoff/diag_pause_closes.md opens the partner page of the pause menu.
scenarios.reason: Log: pause opens (game mode 10 at frame 96). Picture: the pause menu stays on the map page, not the partner tab, so the R*2 steps do not reach the partner page. The ui: partner line never logs. Needs the exact tab steps.
